head: 830f7ce8ef55f018fd4ad6301f97001a6a05bb93
scope: DX43 thread/start and thread/resume response projection, bridge lifecycle event, tests and pinned schema0.157

checks.conclusion: Missing properties stay missing; malformed, oversized, redacted or unknown policy properties stay invalid; optional false/null/empty are preserved only when actually reported. ReasoningEffort is an open nonempty string in the pinned schema, not a closed guessed enum.

Allowlist8fields;32references;4096bytes per path;16384bytes per field;48000bytes observation. Transcript/thread body and instruction contents are excluded. Redaction-changing values become invalid/redacted rather than masked policy facts. No filesystem or credential lookup added.

Observation is detached from the exact RPC response after thread identity validation, before early-notification registration. Bridge binds canonical server/executor/session/epoch and emits lifecycle with operation_id absent; reversed consumption and resume tests exercise distinct responses.
No change to launch arguments, approval requests, command effects or native policy. No additional native RPC. Existing discovery still follows the new Core-originated observation.

Actual native transport rejects invalid JSON Unicode; thread identity is bounded to256characters before projection. Direct helper calls outside this validated adapter path are not a newly supported untrusted API.

Read schema validation, missing/default distinction, unknown/malformed/oversized policies, secret-redaction, reversed session consumption, resume source, SQLite durability/replay and foreign namespace assertions. No tests executed by this reviewer.

limits: Read-only source review only; no suite, browser, native CLI, provider, service or credential access.
Reported means metadata returned by the start/resume response; not proof of enforcement, instructions contents, file existence, later policy changes, successful tool use, model output or billing.
NativeSecretRedactor uses known injected child secrets plus existing generic patterns; this change is not a universal detector for arbitrary unknown secrets.
Protocol fixtures and SQLite replay tests do not establish a real provider campaign or DX43 runtime acceptance by themselves.
